leadText: (Japanese: ポケットモンスター～ぷっちぐみ ～ Pocket Monsters ~Pucchigumi SP~) is a series by おりとかほり Kahori Orito. It is an adaptation of Pokémon Horizons: The Series and briefly summarizes the main events from The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) to The Future I Choose. It was serialized in the magazine in the June / July 2023 issue (released on April 28, 2023) and the August 2023 issue (released on June 30, 2023).
